notes.title: DLC with Soundtrack now available
notes.notes:
Finally the original Soundtrack to Vacate the Room is released. Also included is the underground Drum'N'Base Remix that was - until now - only known to inside members of the scene. 

Also included in this DLC is the complete Guide to Vacate the Room in case you need help solving a few of the harder puzzles.

The third item in this DLC is a set of Printout Puzzles. These are 4 unique Puzzles with relation to Vacate the Room. A secret message might or might not be included.

notes.title: Commercial use
notes.notes:
Hello all you VR-Cafés and Venues,
finally you are able to use [b]VR: Vacate the Room[/b] to earn money:
Just purchase the commercial license from the steam page and let your customers vacate the room.

Depending on what you charge your customers you might be able to get the cost back from just one session. Sounds really awesome, right?

(you nee to register your café/venue/arcade here first to see the commercial version: https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=3303-QWRC-3436 )

Greetings

hOSHI*

notes.title: Release! Achievements! Ex-Mode!
notes.notes:
It's done!

[b]VR: Vacate the Room[/b] has left the Early Access!
And it comes with a few perks:

[list]
    [*]Steam Achievements
    [*]An EX-Mode with a last hard puzzle
    [*]An alternative ending
[/list]

So have fun, try to solve the mystery, get all the Achievements. 
But be careful:
It might not be a good idea to refuse to leave!

Be quick, the price might go up a bit soon ...

Thanks for playing and the really helpful feedback
and see you later.

greetings

hOSHI*
PS: please report bugs in the discussions as always. I will try to fix them as soon as possible :)

notes.title: Updated Version
notes.notes:
[b]VR: Vacate the Room[/b] just got updated. 
From the feedback I got from your nice reviews, comments and youtube videos (which I really enjoyed), I learned that there were a few problems that occured:
[list]
    [*]Unreachable Objects
    [*]No swapping items between hands
    [*]Some note was readable too early
[/list]

This got fixed:
[list]
    [*]A cane now helps getting far objects (for too small rooms)
    [*]objects are now swappable
    [*]The note should be harder too read (too early)
[/list]

Be careful with the cane though. It can mess up the room quickly (as in real life)
;)

Have fun playing

hOSHI*
